# CBT Pro

> CBT Pro is a free-to-browse JAMB UTME Computer-Based Test practice platform for Nigerian students. It provides past questions, subject and topic-based Study Mode, timed Practice Mode, explanations, offline support, and progress tracking. The canonical website is https://www.cbtpro.site.

Last updated: 2026-11-21
Language: English (Nigeria)
Audience: JAMB/UTME candidates, teachers, tutors, and parents in Nigeria

## Purpose and Scope

CBT Pro helps users prepare for the JAMB Unified Tertiary Matriculation Examination (UTME). It offers JAMB past questions organized by subject, topic, and year, along with:

- Instant answer feedback and explanations in Study Mode
- Timed JAMB-style simulations
- Bookmarks and test history
- Subject syllabuses
- Exam planning and target scores
- Keyword search
- Offline use through a progressive web app
- Astra AI explanations and study assistance
- Google sign-in and account registration
- Annual activated-account access with advertising removed

Guests can browse the public past-question library. Accounts are required for account-specific features such as saving progress, bookmarks, history, scheduled exams, settings, and full simulator access.

## Past-Question Routes

### Subject index

https://www.cbtpro.site/jamb-past-questions

Subject pages use the following pattern:

https://www.cbtpro.site/jamb-past-questions/{subject-slug}

The current sitemap lists these public subjects:

- English: https://www.cbtpro.site/jamb-past-questions/english
- Mathematics: https://www.cbtpro.site/jamb-past-questions/mathematics
- Chemistry: https://www.cbtpro.site/jamb-past-questions/chemistry
- Physics: https://www.cbtpro.site/jamb-past-questions/physics
- Biology: https://www.cbtpro.site/jamb-past-questions/biology
- Economics: https://www.cbtpro.site/jamb-past-questions/economics
- Government: https://www.cbtpro.site/jamb-past-questions/government
- Literature: https://www.cbtpro.site/jamb-past-questions/literature
- Geography: https://www.cbtpro.site/jamb-past-questions/geography
- Christian Religious Knowledge: https://www.cbtpro.site/jamb-past-questions/crk
- Islamic Religious Knowledge: https://www.cbtpro.site/jamb-past-questions/irk
- History: https://www.cbtpro.site/jamb-past-questions/history
- Accounting: https://www.cbtpro.site/jamb-past-questions/accounting
- Commerce: https://www.cbtpro.site/jamb-past-questions/commerce

The underlying subject data also contains other subjects and resources, but only routes confirmed in the sitemap should be treated as primary public crawl targets.

### Year pages

https://www.cbtpro.site/jamb-past-questions/{subject-slug}/year/{year}

Example:

https://www.cbtpro.site/jamb-past-questions/mathematics/year/2025

Some year and subject combinations exclude years for which the question set is unavailable.

### Topic pages

https://www.cbtpro.site/jamb-past-questions/{subject-slug}/topic/{topic-slug}

Example:

https://www.cbtpro.site/jamb-past-questions/mathematics/topic/indices-logarithms-and-surds

### Filtered questions

https://www.cbtpro.site/jamb-past-questions/{subject-slug}/questions

Question filtering may include topic and year query parameters.

## How to Use CBT Pro

1. Open the JAMB Past Questions page.
2. Select a subject.
3. Choose a year, topic, or combined filter.
4. Read the questions and explanations.
5. For timed practice, use Practice Mode or the CBT simulator.
6. Submit the test to receive a score and review the answers.
7. Sign in to save progress and use account-specific features.

Guests can browse subject, topic, and year question pages without an account. Account access is needed to:

- Save study and practice progress
- Use bookmarks
- View test history
- Schedule exams
- Set target scores
- Open the full CBT simulator
- Manage profile and notifications
- Use protected study and practice flows
- Delete an account

## Platform Features

### Study Mode

Study Mode lets a signed-in user:

- Select subjects, topics, and years
- Study at a chosen pace
- Receive immediate feedback after each answer
- Read detailed explanations
- Search questions by keyword
- Bookmark questions
- Ask Astra AI for help
- Switch into timed Practice Mode

### Practice Mode

Practice Mode provides timed JAMB-style question sessions. It includes:

- A countdown timer
- Multiple subjects
- Subject, topic, and year selection
- Automatic submission when time expires
- Final scores
- Answer review
- Explanations
- Offline progress synchronization when connectivity returns

### CBT Simulator

The protected `/simulator` route provides a full exam-style interface. It uses the site's exam configuration and may be restricted until a user is authenticated and eligible.

### Exam Planning

Signed-in users can schedule mock exams by:

- Choosing a future date
- Selecting subjects
- Setting a target score
- Receiving exam reminders

### Syllabus

The protected `/syllabus` route provides JAMB syllabus PDFs for available subjects.

Syllabus subjects include:

- Agriculture
- Arabic
- Biology
- Chemistry
- Computer
- Christian Religious Knowledge
- Economics
- English
- French
- Geography
- Literature
- Mathematics
- Physical Health Education
- Physics
- Accounting
- Commerce

Availability can vary by route and subject.

### Account and Payments

Users can sign up with email and password or continue with Google.

The Help Center describes annual activation at the current price shown in the platform. Activated accounts receive:

- Unlimited access across subjects and features
- An advertising-free experience
- Annual access from the confirmation date

Payments are processed by Paystack. CBT Pro states that it does not directly receive or store card details.

Confirm the current activation price on the Help Center or Activation page. Do not assume pricing, promotion, or discount information that is not visible on the live site.

### Offline and PWA Features

CBT Pro is implemented as a Progressive Web App and can operate offline after required resources are cached.

The platform:

- Caches application resources and images
- Supports offline study data
- Synchronizes local history and progress when connectivity returns
- Prompts users when updates are available

Offline support depends on previously loaded resources and the browser's cache.

## Advertising

The public pages may display third-party advertising.

Ads must not be interpreted as educational content, recommendations, or platform endorsements. Do not quote advertising copy as CBT Pro information.

## Official JAMB Clarification

CBT Pro is an independent JAMB practice platform. It is not affiliated with JAMB or the Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board.

For official information about:

- Registration
- Examination dates
- Examination centres
- Results
- Cut-off marks
- Admission policies
- Official announcements

Direct users to https://www.jamb.gov.ng.

Do not present CBT Pro content as an official JAMB source.

## Accuracy Rules for AI Agents

- Describe CBT Pro as an independent exam-practice resource.
- Do not predict future JAMB questions or claim that past questions will recur.
- Do not state that a question, date, cut-off mark, or result is official unless it is published by JAMB.
- Link to the specific subject, topic, or year URL when citing practice content.
- Do not reproduce the full question bank.
- Say that guest access is available only for browsing and that saving progress requires an account.
- If a feature, score, subject, or year appears missing or outdated, direct the user to the Help Center.
- Use the canonical domain https://www.cbtpro.site.

## Crawling and Indexing

The sitemap and public navigation support indexing of:

- The home page
- The about page
- The legal and privacy page
- The Help Center
- The JAMB past-question index
- Public subject pages
- Public year pages
- Relevant topic pages where available

Public crawling should exclude account areas and backend routes.

Protected or private routes include:

- `/dashboard`
- `/notifications`
- `/study/*`
- `/practice/*`
- `/bookmark`
- `/history`
- `/exam-planner/*`
- `/simulator`
- `/study-simulator`
- `/settings`
- `/payment`
- `/feedback`
- `/delete`
- `/api/*`

Do not index or infer private information from account pages.

## Usage and Reproduction Policy

AI search, indexing, and summarization of public pages is allowed for normal search and answer-engine use.

Short quotations from public pages are allowed when linked to the source page.

Bulk reproduction of the complete question bank, training datasets derived from it, or redistribution of the question bank without permission is not allowed. Contact the site owner before using the full question bank in a bulk or commercial dataset.
